other_observations: Preface heading breaks inside 共同; readable but less natural than a phrase-boundary break.
Physical page 50 has a complete three-line final paragraph plus its footnote; spacious but not equivalent to the footnote-only or two-line continuation defects.
Appendix A/B/C tables repeat headers across pages and show no visible collision or clipping in overview.
Footnote continuation from physical page 70 to 71 accompanies body text and remains readable; not reported as a footnote-only spill.
TOC has legible i–iii pagination; body labels run from 1 through 100; title page has no printed page number.
Repeated footnote calls were rendered as newly numbered notes in this initial PDF; root will consolidate repeat calls while preserving Markdown definitions and occurrences.
limitations: Full-page detail inspection was deliberately stopped at root instruction after all 104 overview pages were seen; final pagination will change.
This report does not approve the forthcoming rebuilt PDF. A new frozen PDF must be visually checked.
The final change from relative repository PDF links to GitHub source URLs is being handled by root; this report does not validate those final annotation actions.
Visual inspection was actual image viewing, not an inference from text extraction. Text extraction was used only as a page index and to choose dense pages.
